_note: The feedback form after the post-test (see autoload/assessment.gd). The ratings are 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree). Each item has a characteristic of ISO/IEC 25010 (the product quality model of Objective 5) or one of the three subjects the objective names (accessibility, gameplay experience, cybersecurity understanding). Keep the ids: the Google Sheet columns are the ids. The characteristics that only an IT expert can judge (maintainability, portability) are not here: they go on the expert checklist.
title: FEEDBACK
comment_prompt: Anything else you want to tell us? (optional)

items.text: The game has everything I needed to learn about the cyber threats it covers.
The game helped me understand cyber threats better.
The challenges of each day matched the threat of that day.
The game responded quickly when I clicked, changed screens and saved.
The game ran on my computer without any extra setup.
I always knew what to do in each phase.
The controls were easy to learn.
The tooltips, the information book and the explanations were clear.
The text, the colours and the sounds were easy to read and to hear.
The game did not crash, freeze or show errors.
My progress was kept when I saved and came back.
I trusted the game with my alias and my answers.
I wanted to keep playing after each stage.
